verdict.rationale: Navan documents unlimited policy and approval workflows, policy limits shown during hotel booking, and transactions that are flagged or declined against policy with routing to approvers, which covers part of the enforcement half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows allocating budgets to teams or projects, or card limits tied to such budgets. Missing for 10: budget allocation to teams/projects, card spend limits that enforce budgets, approvals gated on budget consumption, and independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
